hero.eyebrow: Engineered for Uncompromising Speed, Security, and Scalability
hero.title: High-Performance Software Crafted for Creators, Publishers, and Institutions
hero.subtitle: VibePress Studio engineers ultra-fast WordPress performance plugins and offline-first native desktop applications. Designed to replace sluggish systems with rock-solid, production-grade tools.

pillars.title: Zero Database Bloat
pillars.desc: WordPress plugins that never clog your database with custom tables or runaway queries, preserving sub-millisecond execution speeds.

pillars.title: Offline-First Desktop Architecture
pillars.desc: Native desktop applications running locally in SQLite WAL mode on macOS and Windows without cloud dependencies or monthly SaaS fees.

pillars.title: Built-In Automated Compliance
pillars.desc: Automated legal disclosures and POS fine calculations built directly into application logic.

pillars.title: Institutional All-In-One Hubs
pillars.desc: Integrated operational modules for cataloging, circulation POS, donor registries, staff rosters, payroll, and expenses.

flagship.title: Production-Grade Engineering Solutions
flagship.subtitle: Explore our flagship software designed for reliability, performance, and complete data sovereignty.

standards.title: Built to Highest Industry Engineering Standards

items.heading: WordPress Core Standards
items.body: Engineered in strict adherence to WordPress Core Coding Standards (WPCS), PSR-4 object-oriented modular patterns, and PSR-12 formatting rules.

items.heading: Native Rust Security
items.body: Powered by Tauri, Rust, and React with native system-level memory safety, local SQLite WAL persistence, and offline data sovereignty.

items.heading: Data Privacy & Sovereignty
items.body: Zero third-party cloud tracking, zero Personally Identifiable Information (PII) telemetry, and 100% offline data ownership.
